The world is grateful for you

Thanksgiving Day blessing cards, each painted small, cut apart, and written on by hand. Draw one, then turn it over.

Tap a card, or let one find you.

Print all eighteen cards for home or centre, six to a page. Free to download.

If these meant something to you, the story of how they were made is on Patreon, and you’re welcome to follow along there.
